values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/highbridge ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (High Bridge State Forest Campground, Luce: 6 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in river access about 50 ft from the parking area on the west side, but steep banks and swift water.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/highbridge ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (High Bridge: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Six 'tent and small trailer sites' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/highbridge ('offers six tent and small trailer sites'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (6 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground along the Two Hearted River (salmon, steelhead, brook trout), a favorite with anglers, 22 miles north of Newberry via M-123 and County Road 407, Luce County; managed by Muskallonge Lake State Park. The banks are steep and the current strong, so river access is hard. ORV and snowmobile riding allowed from the campground to the Pine Ridge and Two Heart trails; snowmobile Trail #8 runs in front. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 6 tent/small-trailer sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (inherited max now confirmed).
